description: Finds pages on sjstorage.net by words (every page in its sitemap: units and prices, sizing guide, space calculator, RV and boat, powered units, commercial, town pages, comparisons, blog, FAQ, contact and the legal pages). Returns up to `limit` pages with title, link and the page's own description, best match first.

limit.description: How many pages at most (1 to 10, default 5).

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "winter RV storage".

name: search_site
